description: Enhancement of risk-based metaheuristic flood evacuation route optimisation algorithms: Data is a data set deposited in Cardiff University by its authors Reza Ahmadian, Man-Yue Lam. Evacuation is an effective measure to enhance urban resilience against flood. Research on optimising evacuation routes, particularly for pedestrian evacuation, is limited. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. Size stated: 2902710 Bytes. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support emergency-service and public-facility studies. Related records: none catalogued yet for this repository.
